headline: Quarterly growth was uneven, with a few firms posting strong top‑line gains while profit momentum lagged for others.
summary: Coforge led revenue growth with a 53.6% YoY increase, supported by an AI‑focused strategy. Mid‑tier players such as LTM and Tech Mahindra delivered double‑digit growth, while Infosys and HCLTech showed modest expansion. Profit growth was mixed; HCLTech posted a 21% jump, but Persistent saw a 25% profit decline. Guidance ranged from trimmed outlooks at Infosys to new FY27 targets at HCLTech and Wipro.

themes.title: AI‑driven revenue
themes.detail: Several firms highlighted AI contributions, with Infosys reporting 29% AI revenue growth and HCLTech’s AI revenue reaching $219 m.

themes.title: Margin pressure
themes.detail: Operating margins compressed for some, notably Infosys (21.0%) and LTM (15.6%), while Coforge lifted its EBIT margin guidance to 16%.

themes.title: Dividend continuity
themes.detail: Most companies maintained or raised interim dividends, signaling cash‑flow confidence.
